newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Warehouse says 2nd qtr sales up 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Warehouse says 2nd qtr sales up 13 pct.

text.p: Retailing chain The Warehouse said on Friday its second quarter sales were 13.1 percent ahead of the year ago quarter, at NZ$233 million.

Subject to the confirmation of both stock valuation and shrinkage from the stocktake currently in progress, the directors said they were confident the group would achieve budgeted profits for the six months to January 31.
They said they were "positive about the group's prospects and remain confident it will trade profitably, having put behind it the problems that beset the group this time last year".
Year-to-date sales were 14.7 percent ahead of the same period last year.
Warehouse's half year profit will be announced on or before April 15.
